test_encode_decode: test the SubwordTextEncoder encode and decode methods for text to id conversion and invertibility
test_build_from_corpus: test building a SubwordTextEncoder from a corpus generator with configurable vocabulary size
test_save_load_from_file: test saving a SubwordTextEncoder to a vocab file and loading it back from disk
test_reserved_tokens: test building a SubwordTextEncoder with reserved tokens like <EOS> and <EOD>
test_build_with_unicode: test building a SubwordTextEncoder from a Chinese text corpus with unicode characters
